$comment: Wren (Island RPG's Wren, from Gull Isle), on the shore. The satchel side quest: a fetch with the inventory.
speaker: Wren

hello.text: Oh! Sorry, I thought you were a gull. A big one. I'm Wren, from Gull Isle. I study the wisps. Or I did, until they stopped turning up.

hello2.text: I've followed the last of them here. And then I lost my satchel. Every note I've ever taken, in one bag, dropped somewhere on the rocks behind the houses.

why.text: Because they're all born here! There's a fire under that hill. My uncle Tomas says I'll fall in it one day.

thanks_early.text: Would you? North-east of the square, among the big rocks. Leather, scuffed, smells faintly of seaweed. Like me.

waiting.text: Any luck? Big rocks, north-east of the square. Smells of seaweed.

found.text: My satchel! You found it! The notes, the sketches... even the sandwich. Don't tell anyone about the sandwich.

found2.text: Take my Vigor Charm. It's a wisp-stone: they hum when you're in trouble and somehow you just... get back up. You'll need it more than me.

thanks_again.text: My notes say the wisps are born in threes and argue constantly. Science! Be careful down there.

after.text: Look at them! Hundreds! I'm going to need a bigger satchel. And a bigger sandwich.
